This receipt records the native renderer response to an unmodified initial
history from the six-member 12/3 km forecast initialized 2022-09-26 00Z.
The writer byte count, hash, member, grid and timestamp are copied exactly.
No model fields are included. The source atmosphere is NOAA GFS, public US
government data: https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-gfs-bdp-pds/
and https://www.weather.gov/disclaimer . The generated receipt and regression
are distributed under this repository's Apache-2.0 license.
